summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Addex Therapeutics Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting a press release about preclinical data for its GABAB PAM candidate. The press release describes encouraging antitussive activity in a bleomycin-induced chronic cough model, with no mention of any corporate transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, capital return, delisting, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing incorporates the press release by reference into existing registration statements. As such, this is an ordinary operational update, not a special-situation event requiring categorization.
